usage: The word "女婿" (neoi5 sai3) refers specifically to the son-in-law, the husband's name is 媳婦 (saang1 fuk6) in Cantonese.
"女婿" is used when talking about the family member who marries your daughter.
You can use "女婿" to talk about your relationship with your daughter's husband.
"女婿" is a common noun and is usually used with possessives like 'my' or 'your' to indicate whose son-in-law is being mentioned.
